title: Should you output logits or log-softmax(logits)?

cues.en: This will be a fairly short video and there's no code demo.
cues.zh: 這支影片很短，沒有程式示範。

cues.en: I'm going to discuss the timing of transforming the model logits into log softmax, and the difference
cues.zh: 要討論何時把模型 logit 轉成 log softmax，以及

cues.en: between doing that inside the model versus outside the language model.
cues.zh: 在語言模型內、外做的差別。

cues.en: These two screenshots here show forward methods from language models that I have presented in different videos in this section.
cues.zh: 這兩張截圖，是這一節不同影片展示的語言模型 forward 方法。

cues.en: What I want you to notice is that sometimes I output here what I call the logits.
cues.zh: 請注意，有時輸出這裡叫做 logit 的值。

cues.en: These are just the raw numerical values from the model processing.
cues.zh: 只是模型處理後的原始數字。

cues.en: And sometimes I transform the logits into logsoftmax before outputting the data.
cues.zh: 有時則先轉成 log softmax，再輸出。

cues.en: So if you noticed this distinction, then you may have wondered why I do it sometimes one way and sometimes the other way.
cues.zh: 如果注意到差別，可能會納悶為何有時這樣、有時那樣。

cues.en: And if you hadn't noticed it, then that's great.
cues.zh: 如果沒注意，也很好。

cues.en: Now you know what to look for.
cues.zh: 現在知道要看什麼。

cues.en: Now, in some sense, it doesn't really matter whether you log softmax inside or outside the model, because the result is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 某種程度上，在模型內、外做 log softmax 沒關係，結果完全相同。

cues.en: However, there is one important implication of this choice for applications in new token generation.
cues.zh: 但對產生新詞元的應用，這個選擇有一項重要影響。

cues.en: And that really has to do with the temperature parameter.
cues.zh: 與溫度參數有關。

cues.en: Remember that the temperature is a divisive normalization factor in the softmax transformation.
cues.zh: 記得，溫度是 softmax 轉換中，用來相除的正規化係數。

cues.en: The issue with calculating logsoftmax here is that once you've done that, you can no longer change the temperature.
cues.zh: 在這裡計算 log softmax 的問題，是做完就不能再改溫度。

cues.en: So here you see a screenshot from a generate method.
cues.zh: 這是 generate 方法的截圖。

cues.en: Now we can actually undo the logarithm simply by applying the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 可以直接用自然指數，撤銷對數。

cues.en: And that does give us back a softmax probability distribution.
cues.zh: 確實能得到 softmax 機率分布。

cues.en: But it does not allow us to completely invert the softmax function, which means essentially that the temperature is fixed to one and there's no way to change that.
cues.zh: 但無法完整反轉 softmax，所以基本上溫度固定為 1，沒有辦法改。

cues.en: On the other hand, if we output the raw logits with no transformations like this, then we actually can change the temperature in the generate method.
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果輸出沒有轉換的原始 logit，就能在 generate 裡改溫度。

cues.en: But on the other other hand, then if you output the raw logits like this, you have to remember to
cues.zh: 但反過來，如果這樣輸出原始 logit，要記得

cues.en: transform into logsoftmax when using the loss function during training.
cues.zh: 訓練時，使用損失函數之前先轉成 log softmax。

cues.en: So here is a brief summary of the implications for having the raw outputs from the model versus calculating
cues.zh: 簡短整理，輸出原始值，以及在模型內計算

cues.en: Logsoftmax inside the model and outputting those logsoftmax values.
cues.zh: log softmax、輸出轉換值，各有什麼影響。

cues.en: Basically, Logsoftmax output is convenient for training.
cues.zh: 基本上，log softmax 輸出方便訓練。

cues.en: It's also great.
cues.zh: 也很適合，

cues.en: It's perfectly fine if the main goal of the model is to classify text, for example in a sentiment analysis or identifying spam messages.
cues.zh: 如果主要目標是文字分類，例如情緒分析或辨識垃圾訊息，也完全沒問題。

cues.en: It's also completely fine for generating new text, but you just have to keep in mind that it's not possible to adjust the temperature of the probability distribution.
cues.zh: 用來產生新文字也可以，但要記得，無法調整機率分布的溫度。

cues.en: Now, that's not necessarily a bad thing, because a temperature of one is the default in a lot of models.
cues.zh: 不一定不好，因為很多模型的預設溫度就是 1。

cues.en: And on the other hand, outputting the raw logits means that you need to remember to apply a transformation before loss calculations.
cues.zh: 另一方面，輸出原始 logit，就要記得計算損失前先做轉換。

cues.en: But in general, this does give you more flexibility for other applications that you might want to apply to the model output.
cues.zh: 但一般而言，對模型輸出想做的其他應用，這樣更有彈性。

cues.en: So the conclusion here is that either way is fine, but it is important for you to know whether the
cues.zh: 所以結論是，兩種都可以，但必須知道

cues.en: data have been transformed so you can treat the data appropriately in subsequent applications.
cues.zh: 資料是否已轉換，才能在後續應用正確處理。
